Type: rattan dining armchair
Use: dining, sitting; dining room, kitchen, sunroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, retro
Materials: rattan frame in a black stained finish, woven rattan seat and spindles
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: curved tub back of vertical bent rattan spindles that wraps into low arms, upright seat, four straight legs with low stretchers, light and open, compact
Feel: airy, graphic, relaxed, crafted
Goes with: light wood or white tables, natural textiles, green plants; bohemian, coastal or Scandinavian dining rooms
